## Pull request overview

This PR standardizes all package versions across the monorepo to version 0.9.0. The changes update version numbers from 0.8.2 (for core packages) and 0.7.x (for examples and root package) to a unified 0.9.0.

**Changes:**
- Updated all package versions to 0.9.0 for consistency across the monorepo
- Updated peerDependencies in `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/plugin-msw` to reference 0.9.0 packages
